The '''Osara system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Mundicide|event]] known as the [[Osara Mundicide]], which took place after the [[Galactic Republic–Kumauri Empire war|war]] of approximately [[10,000 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Kumauri Empire]] and which involved the use of [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannons]] for [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Osara [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
